lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: value of the 2-bit lockMode field before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: value of the 2-bit lockMode field after rebaseOraclePack executes, reported as '00'

assumptions: rebaseOraclePack execution is the checked transition; the report does not state caller authorization.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact prior lockMode value (only that Guardian sets it to 3), so the expected preserved value is symbolic rather than a concrete literal.

limitations: The correspondence pattern requires a rebase_executed trigger symbol; the report does not explicitly name an occurrence flag, so it is declared as a bool occurrence observable for the transition.
Only the selected impact lockmode_cleared is formalized; other impacts are handled separately.
